title: bromus squarrosus var. typicus
intro: Bromus squarrosus var. typicus, commonly known as the rough brome, is a type of grass belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues. The health benefits of Bromus squarrosus var. typicus are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, expectorant, and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
